name: Star Breeze

seo.title: Star Breeze in Tahiti: Windstar's 312-Guest All-Suite Yacht | James Wild & Co
seo.description: Star Breeze is Windstar's 312-guest all-suite yacht, sailing French Polynesia year round from Papeete, with longer voyages to the Tuamotu, the Marquesas, Fiji and the Cook Islands.

tagline: Windstar's all-suite yacht for 312, sailing Tahiti year round.
answer: Star Breeze is Windstar's 312-guest all-suite yacht, and she sails French Polynesia year round, with voyages almost every week from Papeete. Beyond the Society Islands she sails longer voyages to the Tuamotu, the Marquesas, Fiji and the Cook Islands, which Windstar combines into Star Collector Voyages of up to 21 days. She is a motor yacht, not a sailing ship: Windstar's sailing yacht in Tahiti is Wind Star, from March 2027.
facts: All suites, from 277 sq ft; Owner's Suites 575 sq ft with a private veranda
overview: Windstar describes Star Breeze as an all-suite yacht for 312 guests, with 200 crew across six guest decks. She is 522 feet long, driven by twin propellers and two Wartsila diesel engines, and cruises at 16 knots.

She is based in Tahiti year round, with voyages almost every week; Windstar's own page puts Tahiti about 8 hours from Los Angeles. Her upcoming voyages begin or end in Papeete, and some run on to Lautoka in Fiji, Singapore and Benoa in Bali.

On board: the Yacht Club Café, Basil + Bamboo, the Compass Rose Lounge and the Yacht Club, World Spa by Windstar with a complimentary sauna, a fitness centre, on-deck hot tubs and a water-access marina. Windstar says all dining is included in the fare.
why: Year round in Tahiti, with voyages almost every week from Papeete, so a sailing fits around the islands rather than the other way round.
Longer routes than most: the Tuamotu, the Marquesas, Fiji and the Cook Islands, joined into Star Collector Voyages of up to 21 days.
Every cabin is a suite, and Windstar includes all dining, 24-hour room service and the water-access marina in the fare.

faqs: How many guests does Star Breeze carry?
Is Star Breeze a sailing ship?
No. Windstar describes her as an all-suite yacht. Its sailing yacht in Tahiti is Wind Star, a four-masted ship for 148 guests, from March 2027.
Does Star Breeze sail Tahiti all year?
Yes. Windstar says she sails Tahiti year round, with voyages almost every week.
Where does Star Breeze go beyond the Society Islands?
On longer voyages to the Tuamotu, the Marquesas, Fiji and the Cook Islands, which Windstar combines into Star Collector Voyages of up to 21 days.
In Papeete, Tahiti. Some voyages run on to Lautoka in Fiji, Singapore or Benoa in Bali.
All dining, specialty dining included, 24-hour room service, the gym and sauna and the water-access marina, per Windstar.
From 277 sq ft; the four Owner's Suites are 575 sq ft with a private veranda.
Where should I stay before sailing?
A night on Tahiti first: InterContinental Tahiti or Le Tahiti by Pearl Resorts, both in the Ledger.

terms: Single occupancy starts at 175% of the per person fare, and 200% on select sailings and in the larger suites, as Windstar publishes.
Windstar's Peace of Mind Promise for sailings through 31 March 2027: a full refund when you cancel at least 121 days before sailing; Windstar's terms apply.
If Windstar lowers the published fare for your sailing and suite, it makes up the difference as a credit, upgrade or fare reduction when asked at least 90 days before sailing.
